name: agent-undo-log
title: Agent action log
description: What an agent did, run by run, with Revert on every action, ⌘Z for the last run and a toast to undo the revert.

AgentActionLogRoot.description: The log on its own: the state, ⌘Z and the list. `AgentActionLogRun`s go inside.

props.name: runs
props.description: The runs, in the order shown: newest first, usually.

props.name: onRevert
props.description: Reverts one action. Return a promise: the button shows a Spinner until it settles, and a rejection marks the row as failed, with Try again.

props.name: onRevertRun
props.description: Reverts what is left of a run in one go (one request), for Revert run and ⌘Z. Gets the actions still in effect, newest first. Without it, `onRevert` runs for each, newest first.

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Puts reverted actions back: the toast's Undo, and Restore on a reverted row or run. Without it the toast has no Undo and a reverted row just says Reverted.

props.name: reverted
props.description: Ids of the reverted actions, controlled.

props.name: defaultReverted
props.description: Ids of the actions already reverted when the log mounts.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Ids of the open runs, controlled.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Ids of the runs open when the log mounts. Default: the first run.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Where ⌘Z (Ctrl+Z off Apple) reverts the newest run: anywhere on the page (`document`, the default), only while focus is in the log (`log`), or nowhere (`off`).

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Writes a time. Default: the time of day, with the date when it isn't today, in `dateLocale`.

AgentActionLogRun.description: One run: a header that opens onto its actions, with Revert run (or Restore run once it's all reverted). Other props, `ref` included, go to its `li`.

props.name: children
props.description: The rows. Default: an `AgentActionLogAction` for each of the run's actions.

AgentActionLogAction.description: One action, an Item: its icon, what it did, what it changed, the time and its button (Revert, then Restore or Reverted; Try again after a failure). One that can't be reverted says why in the button's place. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `li`.

props.name: state
props.description: Sets the row's state yourself, for a log you drive. Default: the log's.

props.name: children
props.description: More under the action's fields: a link to the record, a note.

AgentActionLog.description: The log from `runs`: each run's header and its actions, Revert on each, Revert run and ⌘Z for the newest. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `section`.
